name: ChatGPT
description: The industry-standard conversational AI powered by the latest GPT-4o and o1 models. It excels at reasoning, coding assistance, and multimodal interaction across web and mobile.

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's flagship assistant known for its natural writing style and massive context window. It is highly regarded for complex reasoning and large-scale document analysis.

name: Cursor
description: An AI-native code editor built on VS Code that understands your entire codebase. It allows for seamless code generation and refactoring using natural language prompts.

name: Midjourney
description: A top-tier generative AI for creating hyper-realistic and artistic images. It operates via Discord and a web interface, producing high-fidelity visuals for professional creative work.

name: Perplexity AI
description: An answer engine that provides real-time, sourced information from across the web. It combines search engine accuracy with the conversational ease of a chatbot.

name: Canva AI
description: A suite of 'Magic Studio' tools integrated into the popular design platform. It helps users generate layouts, remove backgrounds, and create images through simple text commands.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: An integrated AI pair programmer that provides real-time code completions within your IDE. It is the most widely adopted tool for developers in enterprise environments.

name: ElevenLabs
description: A leading AI platform for high-quality voice synthesis and cloning. It can turn text into lifelike speech in dozens of languages with nuanced emotional control.

name: Runway
description: A creative suite for professional video generation and editing using Gen-3 models. It offers tools for text-to-video, image-to-video, and advanced motion brush control.

name: Notion AI
description: An AI assistant embedded directly into Notion workspaces to help with writing and organizing. It can summarize long notes, draft project plans, and extract action items.

name: Figma AI
description: Enhances the UI/UX design workflow by generating editable components and layouts. It helps designers automate repetitive tasks like layer naming and wireframing.

name: Grammarly
description: An AI-powered writing assistant that checks for grammar, tone, and clarity. It integrates into browsers and office suites to ensure professional communication everywhere.

name: Descript
description: An innovative editor that lets you edit video and audio by editing the transcribed text. It features powerful tools like 'Overdub' for voice correction and automated studio sound.

name: Jasper
description: A specialized AI for marketing teams to create on-brand copy and content. It handles everything from SEO blog posts to social media campaigns at scale.

name: Replit Agent
description: An autonomous AI agent that builds and deploys full-stack applications from a single prompt. It manages the environment, dependencies, and code directly in the browser.

name: Synthesia
description: Creates professional videos with AI avatars that speak and express naturally. It is primarily used for corporate training, marketing, and localized video content.

name: Zapier Central
description: An AI agent workspace that connects your favorite apps through thousands of integrations. It allows you to build custom bots that execute complex cross-platform workflows.

name: Adobe Firefly
description: A family of generative AI models integrated into Adobe Creative Cloud apps like Photoshop. It enables high-quality generative fill, text-to-vector, and texture generation.

name: Grok
description: X’s native AI assistant with real-time access to the platform’s live data stream. It is known for its witty personality and ability to analyze current trends and news.

name: Gemini
description: Google’s multimodal AI integrated across the Workspace ecosystem. It features deep integration with Google Search and high-speed processing of text, video, and code.
